faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ITI Geedam Guest Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your offline application for the Guest Lecturer post at ITI Geedam is 25th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Guest Lecturer position at ITI Geedam is 18 years. There is no specified maximum age limit in the provided details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Lecturer post is Rs. 140 per hour, with a maximum of 5 hours per day, leading to a maximum monthly salary of Rs. 15,000.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications for the Guest Lecturer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed High School or equivalent or 11th grade. Additionally, they need to possess an NTC/NAC from NCVT/SCVT or a Diploma/Degree in Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any preference given to certain candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates who have passed CTI/ATI/NTTI/RTTI/ITI.

faq.question: Q6. How is the selection process conducted for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a merit list, which is prepared considering the marks obtained by the candidates in their technical qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the ITI Geedam Guest Lecturer recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post or as instructed.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any application fees for this post?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Guest Lecturer - Workshop Calculation & Engineering Drawing (WCS & ED) at ITI Geedam.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of ITI Geedam. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
